ai_assisted_science: Nature Computational Science and cross-disciplinary results

selected_sources.evidence: Peer-reviewed research article plus mission release.
Authoritative dataset announcement; this is a data release, not a new trend result.
Peer-reviewed open research page with methods, performance and data/code availability.
Open-access peer-reviewed article; full research page, figures and methods inspected.
Peer-reviewed article plus public code/reproducibility repository.
Peer-reviewed article plus deposited proxy and age-model data.
Peer-reviewed randomized clinical trial; full article, protocol-linked methods, tables and limitations inspected.

screened_not_selected.reason: No new, independently substantiated result within the exact window cleared the threshold. The Riemann-hypothesis claim and joint verification statement were dated before this window; 23 November clarification posts did not constitute a new theorem or verification event.
Routine publicity, application deadlines and previously reported mission-selection announcements were excluded.
Reviews, research summaries and observational associations without a stronger same-window contribution were excluded.

access_gaps: Some dynamic publisher indexes and subscription-gated supplementary files could not be screened exhaustively.
Several Nature Portfolio articles were available as accepted early versions subject to copy-editing.
A quiet or unselected field is not evidence that no research appeared in that field.
